card.fires_on: The pole responds to the middle or end piece of a split-up word, such as "uffle" in truffle, "olf" in Rudolf or "el" in Arundel. It is strongest on truffle in food or nature text, and also fires on piece-ends of proper names.

modes.label: Truffle
modes.description: The piece "uffle" after "tr" in the word truffle.
modes.example: red wine, tr<<uffle>> oil, parmesan cheese, sun

modes.label: Name pieces
modes.description: The ending piece of a split personal or place name, such as Rudolf, Arundel or Ruffec.
modes.example: Hans Reichenbach and Rud<<olf>> Carnap as his supervisors.

card.plain: It fires partway through a few rare words, mostly truffle and some names like Rudolf and Arundel.
